title: GeekWire podcast (Todd Bishop) — 'a shift to mission primacy' in Incorruptible
summary: Bishop co-founded GeekWire, the Seattle tech publication, and hosts its podcast. He recorded the episode with Eric straight off the stage at a Seattle startup day where Eric had given the opening keynote, and GeekWire ran a companion article.
blockquote: We talked about the Musk v. OpenAI trial, the fall of Whole Foods, what he told Anthropic’s founders about their corporate structure, and why he thinks shareholder primacy is already dead.
attribution_title: Seattle tech publication; podcast hosted by co-founder Todd Bishop
